Third-party code and data bundled with this app
================================================

vendor/geo.js
  A minified bundle of two small open-source libraries (no other code), used for the globe and map:
    d3-geo 3.1.2 (with d3-array 3.2.5)  - Copyright 2010-2026 Mike Bostock - ISC licence
    topojson-client 3.1.0               - Copyright 2016 Mike Bostock - ISC licence
  ISC licence: Permission to use, copy, modify, and/or distribute this software for any purpose with or without
  fee is hereby granted, provided that the above copyright notice and this permission notice appear in all copies.
  THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND THE AUTHOR DISCLAIMS ALL WARRANTIES.

geo/world.json and geo/states/*.json
  Simplified country and state/province boundaries derived from Natural Earth
  (naturalearthdata.com, 1:50m admin-0 countries and 1:10m admin-1 states and provinces). Natural Earth is
  in the public domain. The shapes are simplified for the web and are for illustration, not for legal borders.
  See scripts/geo/README.md for how they were produced.
